bio: Yoshizumi Nagaya's Michelin-starred cuisine can now be sampled in two different locations in Düsseldorf. Not far from the original restaurant, also located in Little Tokyo, Yoshi opened in October 2016. The food is classically Japanese with subtle European influences here and there. In the evening, the omakase set menu wins over diners with its absolutely ingredient-led and exceedingly precise preparation. It is accompanied by a large selection of sakes. In a way, the minimalist interior design is a reflection of the pared-down style of the dishes. On Fridays and Saturdays, Yoshi is also open for lunch, serving a four- or six-course set menu. Lots of the diners are Japanese – which speaks for itself! Tip for motorists: Use the multi-storey carpark at Kreuzstraße 27....
